role: The End credits screen, opened by the S2B game-state change after the exit portal: a scrolling end.txt/credits.txt roll that pauses the game until Escape sends the respawn C16.
scope_reason: The End is vanilla and in scope (SPEC Decisions: villages on, all worldgen vanilla); the credits' escape-to-respawn changes server state (the C16 and the respawn), so the native engine mirrors the screen as a state flag even though it draws no pixels.

members.name: updateScreen
members.note: the clock and the roll's end (surv_credits_end), in the tick: idx-credits-s1

members.name: keyTyped
members.note: escape while screen_credits sets the respawn input; the comment at play.c:2513 names GuiWinGame.keyTyped

members.name: func_146574_g
members.note: the ["respawn"] op sends the C16 PERFORM_RESPAWN, clears screen_credits and restores focus (survival.c:4279-4285)

members.note: player.c:1245 sets game_paused from screen_credits; serverreplay.h:284 documents the pause

notes: Member statuses from the survival.c/play.c reads only; I did not run any replay to re-confirm end-exit-s1 still passes. lane/idxclient: the roll's own end in the tick (surv_client_input): updateScreen's clock past (569 * 12 + 240 + 240 + 24) / 0.5 (end.txt and credits.txt wrap to 569 lines for Player on the oracle's 240-pixel scaled screen) sends the PERFORM_RESPAWN and closes the screen; the playable client ends it on the same clock. idx-credits-s1 waits out the roll: the screen closes at row 15913 (master keeps it open there), 17,397 rows, play_check 0.
